full_prompt_en: A square romantic realist oil portrait shows a young woman from the shoulders upward, her pale face surrounded closely by dense flowers and foliage in dark autumn colors. Her head is near the center but turns slightly to the right, while her brown eyes look directly toward the viewer. Soft dark curls cross the forehead and disappear into the shadowed floral surround. The smooth oval face carries warm ivory skin, muted rose cheeks, and small closed lips; the expression is calm and reflective. At the upper left, a large ocher-yellow blossom catches bright light among deep green leaves and wine-red petals. Smaller russet, cream, and burgundy blooms cluster above her hair, along the right edge, and beside her neck. The floral mass is not arranged as a separate bouquet; it fills the background so densely that only pockets of near-black ground remain between leaves and blossoms. Around the lower edge, a dark patterned garment merges with the foliage, interrupted by a narrow warm-gold neckline and a few copper strokes at the shoulder. Her illuminated face has the clearest contours, while the outer petals, fabric, and dark leaves are more loosely painted with broken, sometimes thick marks. Soft frontal light from the upper left brightens the forehead, cheeks, and prominent yellow flower, then fades into olive and brown shadow toward the edges. The layered flowers create a shallow, enveloping space, placing the face against richly textured color rather than an identifiable room. Individual small petal highlights glimmer through the darkness without making the whole image bright. No readable text is visible. The overall composition balances a quiet, luminous face with an abundant dark floral frame, joining delicate flesh modeling to dense, warm-toned painterly ornament.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形浪漫主义写实油画肖像呈现一位年轻女子肩部以上的近景，浅色面容被深沉秋色的密集花朵与叶片紧紧围绕。头部靠近中央，略向右转，棕色眼睛却直视观者。柔软深色卷发横过额头，随后融入带阴影的花丛。平滑的椭圆面容带暖象牙色肌肤、低调玫瑰色双颊与小巧闭合的嘴唇，神情平静而沉思。左上方，一朵大赭黄色花在深绿叶片与葡萄酒红花瓣之间接住明亮光线。较小的赤褐、奶油与酒红花朵聚在发顶、右边缘和颈旁。花丛不是独立摆放的花束，而是密密填满背景，仅在叶片与花朵间留下近黑的小空隙。下边缘一件深色花纹衣服融入枝叶，只有狭窄暖金色领口和肩上的几笔铜色打断它。受光面容有最清楚的轮廓，外围花瓣、衣料与深叶则采用更松散、有时厚重的碎笔触。来自左上方的柔和正面光照亮额头、双颊和显眼的黄色花，随后向边缘消退成橄榄与棕色阴影。层叠花朵构成浅而包裹的空间，让脸贴在肌理丰盛的色彩前，而非可辨认的房间里。细小的花瓣高光在黑暗中闪动，却没有让整幅画都明亮。看不到可读文字。整体构图以安静发亮的面容平衡丰盛深色花框，把细腻肌肤塑形与浓密暖色绘画装饰结合。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a romantic realist oil finish that contrasts smoothly blended focal planes with thick, broken ornamental texture. Warm ivory and pale rose provide a luminous center, surrounded by olive, near-black brown, burgundy, ocher, and copper. Outer details overlap densely, with small irregular highlights appearing among darker masses rather than in an even repeat. Soft frontal light favors the central plane and a few nearby accents, while the edges sink into rich warm shadow. Contours are clear at the focal boundary but become lost among layered surrounding marks. The space is shallow and enveloping, with ornament functioning as a textured frame and color halo. The overall effect is intimate, lush, and slightly mysterious.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有浪漫主义写实油画完成面，以平滑晕染的焦点平面对照厚重破碎的装饰肌理。暖象牙白与浅玫瑰色提供明亮中心，周围环绕橄榄色、近黑棕色、酒红、赭黄和铜色。外围细节密集交叠，细小不规则高光在深色块间出现，并非均匀重复。柔和正面光偏爱中央平面和附近少数强调，边缘则沉入丰厚暖影。焦点边界清楚，随后在层叠外围笔迹里消失。空间浅而有包裹感，装饰起到有肌理的框架和色彩光环作用。整体效果亲密、繁茂并略带神秘。
theme_en: A young woman's face framed by dense autumn-colored flowers
theme_zh: 密集秋色花丛围绕的年轻女子面容
name: Hans Makart
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
